arrival.directions: Coming in from outside? Enter the 1st floor through the south-west doors, or through the north doors (go down both sets of stairs and around the corner). Take the stairs beside room 1-3A, or the elevator, up to the 2nd floor, then walk past the right side of the elevators to reach Stop 1.

stops.directionsToNext: Walk around the right side of the round stairwell. Formula Racing is just past it.
Head east into the open hall for the Undergraduate Design Courses.
Keep heading east through the double doors. Aero Design is in front of the elevator.
Mission SpaceWalker is a few steps south, across the hallway.
Take the east stairs or the elevator up to the third floor. ARVP is right there in the east corridor.
Walk west along the corridor. Room 3-26 is on your right.
Leave Room 3-26 and walk west along the main corridor.
Continue west to the end of the corridor. UAARG is just past the corner, by the central stairs.
Room 3-1 is just south, through the doors on the corner.
Head back out and west past the elevator. Engineers for a Sustainable World is in front of it.
Walk back toward the central stairs. The MEC E Club is beside them.
Go north past the stairs. The Mechatronics Club is at the top of the hallway.
Turn left and head west. Room 3-10 is in the north-west corner.
That's the end of the tour. Use the west elevator or stairs to head back down.
